mapper.select: SELECT chk01_class_tree_id AS class_tree_id, chk01_company_id AS company_id, chk01_parent_tree_id AS parent_tree_id, chk01_class_tree_nm AS class_tree_name, chk01_seq AS seq, chk01_use_yn AS use_yn, chk01_note AS note, chk01_link_cd AS link_code, f_cdnm('ChkLinkCode', chk01_link_cd, chk01_company_id, f_sysdate()) AS link_name, 0 AS depth FROM chk01_class_tree WHERE chk01_parent_tree_id = #{parentTreeId} ORDER BY chk01_seq, chk01_class_tree_nm COLLATE "ko-KR-x-icu" ASC

SELECT chk01_class_tree_id AS class_tree_id, chk01_company_id AS company_id, chk01_parent_tree_id AS parent_tree_id, chk01_class_tree_nm AS class_tree_name, chk01_seq AS seq, chk01_use_yn AS use_yn, chk01_note AS note, chk01_link_cd AS link_code, f_cdnm('ChkLinkCode', chk01_link_cd, chk01_company_id, f_sysdate()) AS link_name, 0 AS depth FROM chk01_class_tree WHERE chk01_class_tree_id = #{classTreeId}

SELECT chk01_class_tree_id AS class_tree_id, chk01_company_id AS company_id, chk01_parent_tree_id AS parent_tree_id, chk01_class_tree_nm AS class_tree_name, chk01_seq AS seq, chk01_use_yn AS use_yn, chk01_note AS note, chk01_link_cd AS link_code, f_cdnm('ChkLinkCode', chk01_link_cd, chk01_company_id, f_sysdate()) AS link_name, 0 AS depth FROM chk01_class_tree WHERE chk01_link_cd = #{linkCode} LIMIT 1

SELECT chk01_class_tree_id AS class_tree_id, chk01_company_id AS company_id, chk01_parent_tree_id AS parent_tree_id, chk01_class_tree_nm AS class_tree_name, chk01_seq AS seq, chk01_use_yn AS use_yn, chk01_note AS note, chk01_link_cd AS link_code, f_cdnm('ChkLinkCode', chk01_link_cd, chk01_company_id, f_sysdate()) AS link_name, 0 AS depth FROM chk01_class_tree WHERE 1=1 AND chk01_use_yn = 'true' AND chk01_company_id IN (0, #{companyId}) AND chk01_parent_tree_id = #{parentTreeId} ORDER BY chk01_seq, chk01_class_tree_nm COLLATE "ko-KR-x-icu" ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO chk01_class_tree ( chk01_class_tree_id, chk01_company_id, chk01_parent_tree_id, chk01_class_tree_nm, chk01_seq, chk01_use_yn, chk01_note, chk01_link_cd ) VALUES ( #{classTreeId}, #{companyId}, #{req.parentTreeId}, #{req.classTreeName}, #{req.seq}, #{req.useYn}, #{req.note}, #{req.linkCode} )
